tests.name: edge functions check the caller's identity (S4 / S-H source guard)
tests.reason: The change is five Supabase edge functions plus a shared caller-auth helper; the community-app bundle is unchanged. Edge functions have no staging project (one shared Supabase), so STAGING-VERIFY does not apply (plan §4, PR-C). The guard fails on origin/main and passes on this branch. After the approved manual dispatch of supabase-functions-deploy.yml the deploy is verified read-only: list_edge_functions shows the new versions, the function logs show no new 401 spike from SocialMediaImportDialog, and no probe is sent to production.
